ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light grey regions occupy the center of both lobes. Deep black pigmentation forms a solid band along the entire leading edge, the median notch area, and the lateral tips. Fine-grained dark mottling and stippling are present within the light grey zones, particularly concentrated near the base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the median notch to the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular spots (barnacles) are clearly visible on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying length and orientation are mapped across both light-pigmented lobes, primarily in vertical and diagonal patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks (scarring) visible across the ventral surface; heavy barnacle colonization on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, complex dark pigmentation pattern resembling a branching or forked shape is located on the right lobe near the junction with the median notch.
